title: Round 31 North Carolina-South Carolina state-frame USGS GNIS source register
scope: All-GNIS starter registers for North Carolina and South Carolina. Every seeded row reproduces one USGS GNIS record screened by exact official name, returned type/state/county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and returned GNIS primary point, and cross-checked on two independent USGS surfaces (USGS GNIS Geocoder; staged-products DomesticNames text via tools/gnis_extract.py; cumulative candidate extract resources/city-subsurface/gnis-candidates-batch7.json with per-state ZIP SHA-256 values). Mount Mitchell, Kuwohi, and Sassafras Mountain additionally carry Domestic Names per-ID identity checks. Kuwohi's seeding here closes the open Tennessee context decision from batch 12.

usgsGeocoder.use: Fuzzy candidate discovery only. A candidate was accepted only when Name, Type, State, County, GnisId, Latitude, and Longitude all matched the intended feature and the point lay inside the intended state. County/census divisions, historical places, and same-name records of another class or county were rejected explicitly where relevant. Screens use the official GNIS name (for example 'Kuwohi', 'B. Everett Jordan Lake'), not local short forms.

gnisDomesticNames.use: Second-surface cross-check of every seeded FEATURE_ID and per-ID identity checks for Mount Mitchell (1013745), Kuwohi (1326387), and Sassafras Mountain (1015279), extracted in a GitHub Actions runner by tools/gnis_extract.py. The current text layout carries no elevation columns, so the summit elevations cite USGS-published values. The candidate extract file is cumulative across batches 7-14; this register is the frozen batch-14 evidence.

selectionRules: VERIFIED=1 is claimed only for an exact official name, compatible GNIS feature class/type, intended state and returned primary county, permanent FEATURE_ID, and an official point returned by a cited USGS service, reproduced identically on the second USGS surface.

Grouped Geocoder Types map explicitly to stored row classes: Cities & Populated Places to Populated Place, Lakes & Reservoirs to Lake for the accepted named lakes and reservoirs (the extract's text class for most batch-14 lake rows is Reservoir; Lake Marion's text class is Lake), Streams & Canals to Stream, and Summit to Summit.
A stored GNIS primary point is never described as a municipal boundary, street-address geocode, generic centroid, shoreline polygon, summit outline, or river centerline.

If exact-name candidates remain indistinguishable, or the state-filtered screen returns no intended feature record, the feature is omitted from that state gazetteer and may appear only as a generalized context corridor.
Statewide frames use explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized corridors; no bundled DEM or surveyed boundary is implied.

northcarolina.title: North Carolina statewide frame (North Carolina-South Carolina batch)
northcarolina.frameNote: North Carolina-South Carolina batch: the Raleigh capital anchor is balanced with BOTH Appalachian high points — Mount Mitchell (6,684 ft, highest east of the Mississippi) and Kuwohi (6,643 ft, Tennessee's highest summit, seeded here on its NC record after batch 12 found no Tennessee record for it) — plus the Norman/Jordan reservoirs and the Cape Fear and Roanoke mouth records. identityDecisions.candidate: Kuwohi (formerly Clingmans Dome), FEATURE_ID 1326387, Swain County NC
identityDecisions.decision: Seeded in North Carolina. Batch 12 established that no Tennessee GNIS record exists for the summit on either surface ('Clingmans Dome' empty under states=TN and states=NC; absent from the TN text). The current official name 'Kuwohi' (restored 2024) returns the Summit record under states=NC at the published summit point, and the NC text reproduces it. Tennessee's frame keeps the mountain as a context corridor and Mount Le Conte as its seeded summit, exactly as batch 12 recorded; this batch closes that decision rather than contradicting it.
identityDecisions.notClaimed: The seeded point is not a surveyed summit outline or a Tennessee-side boundary claim.

knownLimitations: North Carolina and South Carolina are starter registers, not statewide GNIS extracts. Each contains 12 deliberately selected identity-safe rows.

The USGS Geocoder is a suggestion service; exact-match screening by official name/type/state/county/FEATURE_ID is part of the evidence. Every seeded row was reproduced on the second USGS surface (staged-products DomesticNames text) at the same primary point.

The current DomesticNames text layout carries no elevation columns, so Mount Mitchell (6,684 feet), Kuwohi (6,643 feet), and Sassafras Mountain (3,553 feet) elevations cite USGS-published values; GNIS identity rests on the per-ID class/county/point reproduction.
GNIS point data do not supply the displayed terrain or corridors. Both frames use explicitly synthetic relief gaussians and generalized context lines.
State frames are rectangles, not state-boundary clipping masks. Both rectangles include areas outside their state outlines (including Atlantic waters); no boundary geometry is claimed.
